Cinnamon Swirl Loaf
From the family recipe binder


Ingredients
8 ounces (227 g) milk, warmed to 110ºF
2 teaspoons instant yeast or 1 packet active dry yeast
3 cups (380 g) all-purpose flour
1/2 cup (113 g) butter, softened
1/3 cup (67 g) sugar
1 teaspoon salt
2 large eggs, room temperature
1/2 tsp of nutmeg (optional)
1 tsp of vanilla extract (optional)
Cinnamon sugar - ½ C sugar and 2 T of cinnamon


If you're using instant yeast, skip the next step, which is only for active dry yeast.


Warm the milk to 110ºF. Stir in 1 tablespoon of the sugar and the yeast and leave for 5 minutes.


Put the flour in a mixing bowl, then add the milk and yeast mixture. Stir on low to combine


While mixing on low, add the sugar, eggs, butter and salt until combined. Add nutmeg and vanilla now if using


Mix on medium until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl and springs back when pressed.


Shape into a ball, place in a greased bowl, cover with a tea towel and let rise for 90 minutes somewhere warm


Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread with butter and sprinkle generously with cinnamon sugar. Roll up tightly


Place in a greased loaf pan and let rise another 30 minutes, then bake for 40 minutes at 350ºF


Turn out of the pan straight away and cool on a rack so the bottom doesn't go soggy


Lovely toasted the next morning!
